sources.role: pinned upstream source: README.rst, ginput.c, eepdump.c, State roadmap
pinned controls, platform scope, EEPROM and state capability

paths.path: The executable base directory; ginput.c loads gamecontrollerdb.txt with SDL_GameControllerAddMappingsFromFile.
paths.naming: gamecontrollerdb.txt is the SDL2 GameController database filename; CUzeBox has no emulator-owned config file.

paths.path: SDL2 GameController mappings are read from gamecontrollerdb.txt beside the executable; keyboard controls are compiled into ginput.c and F8 toggles SNES/UZEM layouts.
paths.naming: SDL mapping lines use the standard GUID,name,platform,logical-field:raw-spec grammar; physical devices are the first two SDL game controllers discovered at runtime.

paths.path: Same directory as the game file; eepdump.c opens the fixed filename eeprom.bin through the game virtual filesystem.
paths.naming: eeprom.bin (exact fixed filename; 2048 bytes) in the game directory/virtual filesystem.

paths.path: No standalone state files: README.rst lists emulator state saves (snapshots) as currently lacking.
paths.naming: No state filename or portable state format exists in the pinned source.

paths.path: No external BIOS; the emulator loads Uzebox game images directly and no canonical firmware checksum applies.
paths.naming: No external BIOS; game images load directly and no canonical firmware checksum applies.
